reason: I'd probably sign up for the free tier, maybe make one dish, and then forget about it like every other cooking app on my phone. Three free dishes a month is already more than I actually cook, so I'd never hit the point where I need to pay.
objection: Talking out loud to an AI while I'm cooking feels awkward, especially if my partner is in the kitchen, and I don't trust a brand-new app with no reviews to really get Thai home cooking right.
would_change_my_mind: If my partner or their family tried it and said the recipes actually taste like home, I'd probably cook more and upgrade.
